method: Read-only Unity YAML and .meta GUID traversal; no Unity invocation, regeneration or Content edits. Counts use unique SkillData assets unless explicitly marked references. Enum values decoded from runtime C# definitions.
scopeNotes: All catalog Characters, Enemy, Enemies, CrossoverVariants and TacticalEnemySkills are traversed.
DisplayName is the exact asset value, including English and Japanese text; absent Korean names are not invented.
Ally source-character classification records character provenance only; individual original-game choreography still needs observation.
SourceNote explicitly distinguishes 37 original names with project-redesigned tactics from 23 project-original boss names.
Enemy records without SourceNote remain project-or-unspecified, rather than asserting original-game fidelity.
Presentation.Pulses is a visual count; it is not the number of gameplay damage applications. EffectCount is serialized SkillEffect entries.
The inventory freezes the baseline before this roster-wide VFX work.

skills.sourceNote: 원작 기술명 · 전술 효과는 본작 재설계: 전방 2칸 타격, 뒤에 선 유닛까지 견제.
